Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was at a four-way intersection in Houston, Texas. I was going straight through on a green light.
Q: Had you been to that intersection before?
A: Yes, I drive through it most weekdays, so I know it well.
Q: Describe what happened when the other vehicle entered.
A: A pickup coming from my right ran the cross street. I saw it at the last second and tried to brake, but it hit the
driver's side of my car.
Q: Were you able to stop, or did you make contact before braking fully?
A: I had started braking but there wasn't time to stop. The impact was on my door.
Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor afterward?
A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room that evening. They checked me over and sent me home with
instructions.
Q: What injuries are you dealing with now?
A: My right shoulder hurts when I raise my arm above my head, and I have stiffness in my neck. I've been doing
physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Have you had any problems with that shoulder before this accident?
A: No, I had no problems with it before. I was atcive and it never bothered me.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still missing work because of the pain, and I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
